ST-O-F5.title: Count-cap overflow can have no substantive overflow evidence.

J07.text: Full S-SPEC case objects (ST-C1..ST-C4) vs exact projections (ST-P2 producer keys id/scope/contract_ref/source_symbols/fixed_inputs/mechanism/negative_authority for all 141; ST-O2 compact-56 + expanded-27 and ST-O3 expanded-58 oracle keys id/scope/contract_ref/fixed_inputs/expected/measured_fields/oracle_predicate/negative_authority). S-ORACLE is meant to derive discriminators and expected results only from the externally SHA-bound selected case and to refuse (HOLD) any expected key it does not enforce. Non-projected keys (source_execution, fixture_identity, hook_set, prerequisites, ownership_scope, native_limits, finite_clause_limits) are seen only in ST-C1..ST-C4; the S-SPEC header L1-272 is owned by ST-C1 and CONTEXT elsewhere.

ST-P1/ST-P2 own the driver; JS-ST1 (supervisor19 L1-1402) and JS-ST2 (supervisor19 L1403-2692) each embed one half of supervisor19 plus the same exact CONTEXT copy of the driver fixture definitions (S-DRIVER L123-124, L311-1217) and declarations of the other half.

J16.text: v13 row -> case mapping (CONTEXT-ROWMAP: central v1 manifest data, unchanged by this repair) vs actual case content. ST-C4 owns the 13 objects that now carry finite_clause_limits; the central v13_rows/case_index credit removal and its explicit open-obligation list are a pending PARENT-owned migration (CONTEXT excerpt in ST-C4). A removed credit must never become silent criterion loss.

J18.text: Parent capture adapter / source reader and the parent five-part release transaction are separate parent-owned implementations, NOT part of this package and NOT implemented, waived or certified here. They must preserve the parent's ORIGINAL created capture descriptor identity, the exact five-field stream schema, actual native exit, fabe57ab bounded date/ownership requirements and the new exclusive owned-/bin/date disposition with successful acknowledgement. The six-key marker's outcome_inode is a driver assertion; outcome origin authentication/replacement detection belongs here and is OPEN. Irreducible external join.

V10-BASE.text: Base role decision 717aebf7: legacy four-source preparation DATA-ONLY, new independent postchecker (approval.verifier, fixed VERIFIER path; UNREVIEWED) the only future base oracle. STATE approvals bind only supervisor/driver/oracle/case_specs and have no base-verifier role. S-DRIVER build_manifest's MODEL creation-channel preparation carries the four source_pins keys {supervisor,child,writer,checker} that supervisor19 creation_manifest requires (supervisor19 L1920) as MODEL data (MODEL paths and zero digests except the real supervisor19 pin); it is neither a legacy pin nor a postchecker pin. Parent central integration must keep preparation_source_pins and base_verifier distinct, must not mechanically repin STATE MODEL data and must not reuse old approvals. CONDITIONAL, parent-owned.

prompt_format.code_and_spec: '<physical line><flag>|<exact text>' per LF line; flag '' = byte-identical unchanged V1 line, '+' = added/changed by the repair; strip through first '|' to recover bytes; range_sha256 over unprefixed bytes
prompt_format.declarations: text-anchored (column-0 def/class and 4-space methods; no AST) signature lines with full-body range sha256 of the peer-owned body; CONDITIONAL
prompt_format.projection: exact JSON values of named keys per case; RULES id==key, scope STATE_ONLY, negative_authority template for non-compact, inherited for compact; GROUP SHARED + per-case object; parse-back verified equal for every case
prompt_format.raw: verbatim bytes between <<<BEGIN ...>>> and <<<END ...>>> with path, inclusive LF range, byte offsets, range/file sha256, bytes, lines
prompt_format.removed_side: '-<V1 line>|<exact V1 text>' under '@@ V1 La-Lb -> S Lc-Ld' change-block headers from the exact native diff; owner = slice owning the block's first added S line (pure deletion: following S line)
prompt_format.requested_reply: line 1 'SLICE <ID> SOURCE-ONLY VERDICT: NO_DEFECT_FOUND_IN_OWNED_BODIES|FIXES_REQUIRED|HOLD — F FATAL, M MAJOR, m MINOR'; A prior-finding table; B findings; C conditional joins; D coverage; E remaining obligations; F no-grant sentence
